激怒萧凡（激怒萧凡（第22页）“侯爷请便。”汪海带着人走进院子，推开房门。屋内陈设简单，一张雕花木床，一张书桌，一个衣柜，几盆兰花。确实什么都没有。汪海目光扫过每一处角落，眉头越皱越紧。竟然藏得这么深！……汪海退到正厅门前，面色平静。林正道脸色铁青，咬着牙开口：“忠义侯，你搜也搜了，可曾找到什么？”“没有。”汪海坦然摇头。“那就请回吧！”林正道一字一顿，“明日早朝，本官定要参你一本！无故带兵围困朝廷命官府邸，纵兵骚扰，搅得鸡犬不宁！忠义侯，你好大的威风！”汪海挑了挑眉，不以为意。“林大人要参，尽管参便是。”他转头看向青鸢，压低声音道：“萧凡还在府里。”青鸢皱眉：“可是各处都搜过了，没有发现。”“藏得挺好。”汪海笑了笑，忽然提高声音，“青鸢统领，你带着凤卫和锦衣卫退至府外，没有本侯的命令，谁也不许进来。”青鸢脸色一变。“忠义侯，这……”“照做便是。”汪海打断她，语气轻描淡写，“莫非你觉得，萧凡能伤到本侯？”青鸢想起那日在小楼中，她随手一击被汪海挡住的事。那一击虽然没用全力，但命丹境随手一击，也不是先天境能扛住的。这个纨绔手里，确实有些底牌。“收队。”青鸢一挥手，“退至府外。”凤卫和锦衣卫鱼贯而出，林府大门重新关上。院子里只剩下汪海、林正道、林若雪，以及几个瑟瑟发抖的丫鬟仆从。汪海负手站在院中，环顾四周，脸上挂着似笑非笑的表情。“萧公子，本侯的人都走了，还不出来？”夜风拂过，无人应答。林正道冷声道：“忠义侯，这里没有你要找的人，请回！”汪海看都没看他一眼，缓步往后院走去。穿过月亮门，绕过假山，走过回廊。他走得很慢，脚步不疾不徐。一边走，一边悠悠然开口。“萧公子，你那妹妹，本侯可是好生疼爱着呢。”“你是不知道，她有多乖巧。”“那日你夜闯侯府，应该也看到了吧？”声音在夜风中飘散，落入假山后、屋檐下、花丛中。没有回应。后院。假山之中。萧凡咬紧牙关，攥着黑渊剑的手指节节泛白。他浑身浴血，右臂的伤口已经在之前的战斗中崩裂，鲜血顺着手腕滴落在地，在青石板上留下一串暗红的痕迹。那条黑龙已经被他收入储物袋中，但代价是又添了几道新伤。本来想趁乱离开，没想到汪海来得这么快。更没想到，他竟然敢把凤卫全部撤走。一个人留在这里。是陷阱。萧凡知道这是陷阱。但汪海说的每一句话，都像刀子一样剜着他的心。璃月……他闭上眼，脑海中浮现出那夜小楼中的画面。璃月跪在汪海身前，埋首于他腿间，做着那种不堪入目的事。而如今，汪海就在眼前。单枪匹马。没有凤卫，没有高手保护。这样的机会，错过了就再也不会有。杀了他。杀了他就能救出璃月。萧凡睁开眼，眼中满是杀意。……

Angering Xiao Fan (Infuriating Xiao Fan (page 22) "Please, Lord Marquis." Wang Hai led people into the courtyard and opened the door. The furnishings in the room were simple, a carved wooden bed, a desk, a wardrobe, and a few pots of orchids. There was really nothing. Wang Hai glanced at every corner, his brows furrowed tighter and tighter. He was hiding so deep!... Wang Hai retreated to the main hall door, his face calm. Lin Zhengdao's face was ashen, and he gritted his teeth and said: "Zhongyi Hou, you have searched, but have you found anything?" "No." Wang Hai shook his head calmly. "Then please come back!" Lin Zhengdao said, "I will lead troops to surround the imperial court tomorrow morning! He sent troops to harass the official's residence, causing chaos! "Zhongyihou, you are so majestic!" Wang Hai raised his eyebrows and didn't take it seriously. "Master Lin wants to participate, so go ahead." He turned to look at Qing Yuan and lowered his voice. Said: "Xiao Fan is still in the house." Qingyuan frowned: "But I have searched everywhere and found nothing." "It's well hidden." Wang Hai smiled and suddenly raised his voice, "Commander Qingyuan, you take the Feng Guard and the Jin Yi Guard with you. Retreat to the outside of the house. No one is allowed to come in without my order." Qingyuan's expression changed. "Marquis Zhongyi, this..." "Just do it." Wang Hai interrupted her in an understatement, "Maybe you think Xiao Fan can. "Hurt me?" Qing Yuan remembered that day in the small building, she was blocked by Wang Hai with a casual blow. Although the blow was not with full force, a casual blow from the Ming Dan realm was not something that the Xiantian realm could withstand. In the hands of this playboy, There are indeed some trump cards. "Call the team." Qing Yuan waved his hand and "retreat outside the mansion." Feng Wei and Jin Yiwei filed out, and the door of Lin Mansion was closed again. Only Wang Hai, Lin Zhengdao, Lin Ruoxue, and a few Se were left in the yard. The trembling servant Wang Hai stood in the courtyard with his hands behind his hands, looking around with a half-smiling expression on his face. "Master Xiao, all my people are gone, why don't you come out?" Lin Zhengdao blew by the night breeze. He said coldly: "Marquis Zhongyi, there is no one you are looking for here, please go back!" Wang Hai walked slowly to the backyard without even looking at him, walked through the moon gate, walked around the rockery, and walked through the corridor. Not so. As he walked, he said leisurely, "Mr. Xiao, I love your sister very much." "You don't know how well-behaved she is." "You should have seen it when you broke into the Hou's house at night. ?" The voice drifted in the night wind, falling behind the rockery, under the eaves, and among the flowers. There was no response. In the backyard. In the rockery. Xiao Fan gritted his teeth, and the fingers that were holding the Black Abyss Sword turned white. He was covered in blood, and his right arm was covered in blood. The wound had cracked in the previous battle, and blood dripped down the wrist, leaving a trail of dark red marks on the bluestone. The black dragon had been put into the storage bag, but at the cost of a few new wounds. He didn't expect Wang Hai to come so quickly. He didn't expect that he would dare to leave Feng Wei alone. It was a trap. But every word Wang Hai said was a trap.都像刀子一样剜着他的心。璃月……他闭上眼，脑海中浮现出那夜小楼中的画面。璃月跪在汪海身前，埋首于他腿间，做着那种不堪入目的事。而如今，汪海就在眼前。单枪匹马。没有凤卫，没有高手保护。这样的机会，错过了就再也不会有。杀了他。杀了他就能救出璃月。萧凡睁开眼，眼中满是杀意。…
